additional_info.subject: RE: ID0437723-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / RD 170003085] Problem with emergency button CRM:02889000208
additional_info.body:
Hello Szymon,
We kindly request you to coordinate a site intervention for this charger. Please adhere to the troubleshooting steps outlined below and also document is attached.
Check Door Sensor Alignment
The door error is likely caused by misalignment or intermittent contact of the door sensor. Ensure the sensor and magnet (or contact switch) are properly aligned and securely mounted.
Inspect Wiring to Door Sensor
Loose or partially connected wires can cause intermittent errors. Check the wiring harness and connectors leading to the door sensor for any signs of looseness or damage.
Verify Door Locking Mechanism
Even if the hinges are fine, the locking mechanism might not be engaging fully. Ensure the door closes firmly and the latch is secure.
Reset the System After Closing the Door
According to the commissioning manual, after closing the door, you may need to reset the residual current circuit breaker before powering on.
Please let us know if you need additional details or assistance.
